categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of antennas and modules, wireless charging modules and related products, EMI/EMC components, high-precision connectors, acoustic devices, automotive interconnection products, and passive components. These products serve key markets including consumer electronics, commercial satellite communications, smart automotive, and IoT/smart home sectors. The company also explores emerging fields such as data centers, AI, low-altitude flight, and humanoid robots.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes research and development in foundational materials and technologies, including high-frequency low-loss polymer materials (LCP, MPI), magnetic materials, ceramic materials, and thermal dissipation materials. It develops advanced RF components like 5G/6G antennas, phased array antennas, millimeter-wave antennas, UWB modules, and high-performance connectors. Manufacturing incorporates automated and semi-automated flexible production lines, with continuous innovation in materials and processes to enhance product performance and integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include globally renowned technology enterprises across consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, wearables, TWS earphones, XR devices), commercial satellite communication providers, smart automotive manufacturers, and IoT/smart home device makers. The company maintains strong relationships with major clients, with the top five customers accounting for over 50% of sales. Emerging markets such as satellite internet, intelligent vehicles, and smart home devices represent significant growth opportunities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with 26 subsidiaries, 11 R&D centers, and 5 main production bases across 8 countries and 18 regions. Key locations include China (Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Mianyang, Yiyang), the United States (San Diego), Japan (multiple cities), South Korea, Switzerland, Sweden, Vietnam, Mexico, and Hong Kong. The company has expanded overseas production capacity with facilities in Vietnam and Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of core components and modules such as antennas, connectors, and passive components. It extends upstream into foundational materials research and downstream into integrated modules and solutions for end devices. The company also engages in technology-driven innovation to enhance its position within the electronic components supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustained investment in R&D with a focus on foundational materials and technologies to maintain product leadership. Key R&D areas are 5G/6G antenna arrays, high-frequency polymer materials, ceramic materials for MLCC, wireless charging technologies, and UWB RF modules. The company pursues a 'materials -> components -> modules' integrated innovation approach and collaborates with leading universities and research institutes globally. It aims to diversify into new growth sectors like commercial satellite communications, smart automotive, and IoT/smart home.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including antennas, wireless charging modules, connectors, acoustic devices, and passive electronic components. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with a small portion through distributors. Sales are conducted both domestically in China and internationally, with a majority of revenue from overseas markets settled in foreign currencies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leading RF components enterprise and one of the earliest in 5G technology R&D. It holds a strong market position in antennas, wireless charging, EMI/EMC components, and high-precision connectors. It competes with major international and domestic electronic component manufacturers and is recognized for its technological innovation and comprehensive product portfolio. The company has received multiple industry awards and maintains close cooperation with top-tier global customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.74 billion, representing a 15.85% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 661.6 million, up 26.89%. The company employs about 13,600 staff worldwide and maintains a strong R&D investment at over 8% of revenue. It has shown steady asset growth and maintains a healthy balance sheet with total assets exceeding RMB 13.3 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its mission to create trustworthy innovative products and solutions through foundational materials and technology research. Its value proposition lies in providing high-quality, customized, and high-performance RF components and modules that meet evolving market demands, especially in 5G/6G communications, smart automotive, and satellite communications. The integrated 'materials -> components -> modules' development capability and global R&D network enable rapid innovation and strong customer collaboration, differentiating it from competitors.
